title: HiNT-RSC: residual smoothing for Hi-C-based copy number variation detection with HiNT-CNV
description: HiNT-RSC is a residual-processing module for HiNT-CNV, the copy-number module of HiNT. It smooths HiNT-CNV's GAM-normalized Hi-C coverage residuals, can subtract a control Hi-C residual or use intra-chromosomal contacts only, and segments the result with BIC-seq2. The repository contains the hint-rsc command-line tool for .hic data and the code, small derived inputs and frozen results that reproduce the APBC 2026 paper (folder paper/).
